thread:
alex-finance: Noticed a recurring metering delta across three separate incidents this quarter. Affected accounts list attached (CSV uploaded). Deltas range 5%-18%. We need a concrete remediation plan + single owner for the billing corrections workflow.

sam-platform: Thanks Alex. I'll take platform lead on root-cause & pipeline fixes. Can you drop the CSV link?

alex-finance: Uploaded: https://redwood.internal/files/metering-deltas-q2.csv. Includes invoice ids, dates, and delta amounts.

jamie-sre: Quick triage: `ingest-processor` worker shows sporadic `CheckpointTimeout` errors around high-latency windows. Backfill runner sometimes replays same batch which can create duplicate ledger rows if de-dupe keys mismatch.

chris-ml: Could be related to recent change in the header sanitizer we shipped last month — it trimmed payloads which changed dedupe keys. I'll grep the commits and add a hypothesis in the incident doc.

lee-eng: Action: add a metric for "ledger-dup-detect" and an alert on >5 dup rows/min. I'll own the metric + dashboard. ETA 48h.

maria-billing: For remediation: we need (1) stop-gap to prevent new duplicates, (2) reingest strategy for missing tokens, (3) invoice correction policy. I'll coordinate with CS. Who can own containment?

sam-platform: I'll do the stop-gap (disable trimming sanitizer in pipeline) & patch. ETA 6h to hotfix + canary. Reingest plan needs a safe diff run first.

ops-bot: ops-bot: scheduled job `backfill-diff` queued at 1760001000 by @sam-platform (dry-run).

alex-finance: Invoice policy proposal: auto-credit if delta <= $25 OR delta <= 5% of invoice. For deltas > $25 or >5% we reissue invoice and notify legal if older than 45 days. Open to feedback.

nora-ops: I'll draft customer-facing language for credits/reissues and a CS playbook. ETA 36h. Will include escalation ladder.

sam-platform: Reingest dry-run command for review: ```sql
-- ledger diff to find missing tokens
SELECT account_id, SUM(expected_tokens) - SUM(ledger_tokens) AS token_gap
FROM metering.expected e
LEFT JOIN metering.ledger l USING (account_id, day)
GROUP BY account_id
HAVING token_gap > 0;
```

jamie-sre: After dry-run completes we'll run a small window reingest (100 accounts) then verify ledger diffs + idempotence. If green, schedule full reingest overnight.

maria-billing: Let's capture action items here:
- Sam (@sam-platform): hotfix patch + canary (6h)
- Lee (@lee-eng): dup metric + dashboard (48h)
- Chris (@chris-ml): repo commit sweep & suspected-PR list (24h)
- Nora (@nora-ops) + Maria (@maria-billing): customer comms + CS playbook (36-48h)
- Alex (@alex-finance): finalize invoice policy + prioritization rules (48h)
- Jamie (@jamie-sre): run reingest dry-run then 100-account test, post results here (after patch)

chris-ml: I'll attach suspected commits to the incident doc: https://redwood.internal/incidents/metering-q2 and tag the ones that touch the sanitizer & dedupe keys.

lee-eng: FYI I'll also add a small unit test in the sanitizer that preserves dedupe key fields when trimming.

sam-platform: Patch PR opened: https://git.redwood/pr/4901. Request review from @lee-eng + @chris-ml. Canary scheduled in 6h.

maria-billing: Weekly follow-up cadence: Mon 10:00 PST until all corrections cleared. I'll own the tracker sheet and publish weekly status.

alex-finance: One ask for prioritization: sort affected accounts by delta absolute $ and churn risk. I'll produce a prioritized reissue queue after Jamie's diff.

nora-ops: Noted. I'll prepare templated credit memos for the < $25 cases to speed CS responses.

jamie-sre: ops-bot: dry-run `backfill-diff` completed at 1760002200. Results: 120 accounts with token_gap > 0, top 20 account list uploaded to the incident doc. Posting clipped diff results here in 10m.

sam-platform: If dry-run matches expectations, schedule full reingest at 2024-06-03T03:00Z to avoid peak traffic.

maria-billing: Thanks team. We'll treat this as a recurring-pattern remediation until the dup metric is stable for 2 weeks. Closing note: keep thread updates concise and drop docs/links to the incident page.
